sources.why_not_scraped: The `owl` template lives in this repo at astro-templates/owl/ and is the structural source of truth — reference-libraries/roofing.json says as much in its note_url_fragility field. Scraping owlroofing.com would only surface Owl's own brand palette and program names, which the library explicitly forbids reusing. Structure comes from the template; palette and typography come from the client's own brand tokens in intake-scraped.json. Firecrawl cost avoided: ~$0.04.

palette_rationale.accent: #ff8604 verbatim from the client's site — it is the primary CTA color on every page of royalroofnepa.com and the dominant color in the logo.
palette_rationale.on_accent: #ff8604 measures 2.42:1 against white, so white button labels fail even the 3:1 non-text threshold. Near-black labels on the orange measure 7.34:1. The client's current site uses white-on-orange and fails; this fixes it without changing the brand color.
palette_rationale.accent_ink: #a8560a is the accent as FOREGROUND TEXT on light surfaces (eyebrows, ticks, stars, pins). 5.25:1 on surface, 4.85:1 on bg. Dark panels keep the full #ff8604, which clears 6.71:1 on --color-primary.
palette_rationale.primary: #0b2233 is a deep navy derived from the client's secondary blue #0977b8. It gives the dark bands (Testimonials, ProcessSteps, WhyChooseUs, hero scrim) a brand-anchored ground instead of a generic charcoal.
palette_rationale.focus: #0977b8 — the client's secondary blue gets one clear job as the focus ring, rather than competing with orange as a second CTA color the way it does on their current site.
palette_rationale.dropped: #cc3366 — a stray magenta in the client's CSS with no visible role. Not carried forward.

contrast_audit.verdict: All pairs clear WCAG AA; most clear AAA.

typography.rationale: Poppins is the client's detected brand face and carries the display voice. Inter handles body text, which the owl template sets at length across SEO body, service long-descriptions and FAQs — Poppins' geometric forms and tall x-height get tiring past a paragraph.

section_styling_hints: Fixed owl section order — hero (full-bleed photo + floating quote card) → promise bar → services grid → testimonials (dark band) → promise band → signature system → process steps (dark band) → about + checklist → SEO body → FAQ → blog row → closing CTA.
Dark bands run on #0b2233 with #ff8604 accents; light sections run on #f4f6f9/#ffffff with #a8560a accent text.
Real project photography from the client's own library — no stock.
One outline icon per section at most, semantic only.
avoid: generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats, generic hard-hat closeup)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template
stacking three competing H1s in the first viewport (the client's current home page does this)
using heading levels as font sizes — the client's current page runs h1 → h5 → h6 → h2 in reading order
white text on the #ff8604 orange (2.4:1 — the client's current buttons fail AA)
the stray magenta #cc3366 from the client's current CSS
duplicating the estimate form multiple times per page
a 50-state dropdown on a form for a single-metro contractor
third-party chat widgets other than the operator's GHL snippet
a second phone number in a sticky mobile bar competing with the primary tracking number
